newsitem.title: UK: Southern Air names Peart senior finance vp.
newsitem.headline: Southern Air names Peart senior finance vp.

text.p: Privately-owned U.S. all-cargo carrier Southern Air Transport said it had appointed J. Robert Peart as senior vice-president of finance and corporate planning.
In an announcement issued here, it also named Thomas Giles as vice-president of operations.

A former corporate banking managing director with the Bank of Montreal , where he was head of its aerospace group, Peart joined Southern in January 1996 and until recently was vice-president of finance and company treasurer, said the announcement.
Giles was previously systems operations co-ordinator with Air Florida. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
